caption: accept() returns a new socket that keeps the same port 80; the listening socket never carries data. The client's 5000 bytes cross on the new socket as three segments of 1500 bytes and one of 500 — four in all.

spec.aria: A client on port 50000 connects to the server's listening socket on port 80; after SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK, accept() returns a new socket that also uses port 80, the client's 5000 bytes travel on that new socket as four segments, a reply comes back, and close() ends the connection.
